injectMode.label: Injection mode
injectMode.helper: Lookup only: constant entries are injected as usual, keyword hits are no longer injected automatically, and the model looks them up when needed. Recommended for large encyclopedic books with hundreds of entries.

activeScene.label: Active in
activeScene.helper: Books written for one-on-one conversation (where the persona refers to the other side as the user a lot) are best limited to private chats.

bookForm.matchWholeWordsHelper: Only affects English and numeric keywords; Chinese keywords are always matched by containment
bookForm.scanNamesHelper: When on, each message is prefixed with its speaker name before keywords are matched: the Bot's own messages use the persona name, other members use their nickname. An entry whose keyword is the persona name hits whenever the Bot has spoken recently; the cost is that a member who renames themselves can also trigger entries in this book that contain that name.
bookForm.scanNamesStDefault: Matches the SillyTavern default for new installs.

semantic.label: Semantic activation
semantic.vectorAllHelper: Besides keywords, an entry is also brought in when recent conversation is close in meaning. Constant entries are always present and do not need this.
semantic.queryMessagesHelper: Counts non-empty messages only, 1 to 10, default 2
semantic.queryMessagesInvalid: Recent messages to use must be between 1 and 10
semantic.maxEntriesHelper: Most entries this book can bring in semantically per round, 1 to 20, default 5
semantic.maxEntriesInvalid: Max entries per round must be between 1 and 20
semantic.thresholdHelper: Below this similarity it is not a hit; 0 to 1, default 0.25
semantic.thresholdInvalid: Similarity floor must be between 0 and 1

entryDialog.stickyHelper: Stay matched for the next N messages after a hit
entryDialog.cooldownHelper: Do not match for N messages after one activation ends
entryDialog.delayHelper: Do not match while the channel has fewer than N messages
entryDialog.trustedHelper: When unchecked, this entry is injected as reference material inside the untrusted block; editing a tenant entry does not automatically make it host content
entryDialog.trustedCreateHelper: Entries created by the platform are always injected as host content; to make one reference material, uncheck this after it is created
entryDialog.tenantTrustedHint: Entries you write are injected as reference material (inside the untrusted block)
entryDialog.ignoreBudgetHelper: After a hit it is not stopped by the global or this book's budget; the per-round entry limit still applies, the tokens it uses still count, and later entries have that much less room. Only takes effect on host entries written by the platform.
entryDialog.ignoreBudgetNotHost: This is not a host entry; the switch has no effect
